label: pjm 90 cchp srmc
definition: PJM 90 CC_CHP SRMC re-grounding on the pjm-89 steam-gas-drag recipe. Completes the pjm-79 SRMC re-grounding for the one class it skipped: CC_CHP economic tranches 0.6624/0.684/0.8208 -> 1.0/1.0/1.05 (Manual-15 composite-cost floor). Measured diagnosis: CC_CHP over-DISPATCHED (grid CF ~48% vs measured net-to-grid ~29%) by bidding sub-SRMC, NOT a BTM capacity issue (merchant 35% BTM is the correct host share). The steam credit is the host's (BTM-removed) so the grid MWh bids at true power-only cost; must-run steam floor untouched. Rule 1 offer physics, registered channel. RESULT vs 923 net-to-grid: CC_CHP 2024 10.7->8.7 TWh (+47%->+19%), 2025 9.6->7.3 (+52%->+16%), 2023 10.0->9.1 (+50%). Aggregate held: coal 122 vs 121 (EIA-930), prices flat. Carries all four pjm-89 corrections (ST_GAS overnight drag, CHP HR, outage capture, coal-bit). OPEN: 2023 CC_CHP still +50%; the last mile is a measured grid-export availability cap (net-export envelope, like retiree_cems_cap) - flagged for owner sign-off (rule-11 framing). KEEPER PROMOTED 2026-07-08, ablation twin registered (2026-07-08-pjm-90-cchp-ablation). Determination NOT-YET: fails C1 fuel-mix (CC_REGULAR 2023 -11.3 TWh / 2024 +13.5 TWh, ST_GAS 2024 -8.0 TWh - volume out of band) and C3c price-tail/scarcity (2025: model 0h vs DA actual 51h >$200) - both pre-existing PJM model misses, not introduced by this change; C2 system volume, C6 governance, C7 diurnal shape and C8 forced-energy all PASS.
market_story: ST_GAS +0.05/0.22 TWh (2024/25): the overnight [0,6] drag is RUC-style reliability commitment holding legacy gas-steam boilers warm at min-load on extreme-temperature / high-net-load days (PJM commits these out-of-merit for local/system reliability) — a thin scaffolding the LP dispatches above, not a volume driver. CT_PEAKER -0.4/-1.1 TWh: the ct_netload_drag holds fast-start peakers in the evening net-load ramp, but with all floors removed the ablation lets CT clear the freed cheap energy economically, so the net cross-class delta is merit-order redistribution, not a CT-specific forced buy. CC_CHP/CT_CHP/COAL deltas <0.15 TWh — the offer/HR/outage corrections move level via price, not forcing.
